title: LAG-MMLU: Benchmarking Frontier LLM Understanding in Latvian and Giriama

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the zero-shot and few-shot accuracy of large language models on multiple-choice questions from the MMLU benchmark across a high-resource language (English) and low-resource languages (Latvian and Giriama) to evaluate performance disparities.

Evaluating how Western-centric knowledge and culturally specific references (e.g., U.S. history or nursery rhymes) in the English MMLU dataset fail to translate or resonate contextually in low-resource languages, impacting model comprehension and evaluation fairness.
